text:
About **0.5 hectares of mapped native forest** overlapped with tree-cover loss detected on the property in 2022.

The total mapped loss event was 0.6 hectares, or 3.41% of the 17.6-hectare property; the remaining 0.1 hectares was outside the mapped forest. A further 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in smaller patches that were not counted as an event; their forest type is not specified.

Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation, its cause, or whether it was legal.
